items.question: Which Cabinet Resolution regulates the activity of operating a crowdfunding platform in the UAE?
items.gold: Cabinet Resolution No. 36 of 2022 Regulating the Activity of Operating a Crowdfunding Platform.
items.fact: Cabinet Resolution No. 36 of 2022 regulates crowdfunding platform operation

items.question: Name the examples of crowdfunding platforms in the UAE.
items.fact: UAE crowdfunding platform examples are Beehive, YallaGive, Tathmeer
